question.text: Among the following, the number of compounds than can react with <math><mi mathvariant="normal">PC</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">l</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>5</mn></mrow></msub></math> to give <math><mi mathvariant="normal">POC</mi><msub><mrow><mtext>l</mtext></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub></math> are <math><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">C</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">H</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>2</mn></mrow></msub><mi mathvariant="normal">S</mi><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><mo>,</mo><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">P</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">O</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>10</mn></mrow></msub></math>

solution.text:
PCl5 on reaction with these 4 compounds gives POCl3

PCl5+SO2→POCl3+SOCl2

PCl5+H2O→POCl3+2HCl

PCl5+H2SO4→SO2Cl2+2POCl3+2HCl

6PCl5+P4O10→10POCl3
